item.title: Celebrate Lunar New Year with “A Night in Shanghai” at Dragonfly, Radisson Blu Pune Hinjawadi
item.description: Pune, 11th February 2026: Usher in the spirit of the Lunar New Year with an immersive culinary celebration as Dragonfly Restaurant at Radisson Blu Pune Hinjawadi presents “A Night in Shanghai” — a thoughtfully curated dining experience inspired by the vibrant food culture of China.
